title: AI-generated faces influence gender stereotypes and racial homogenization

bias_targets.methodology: Using a custom face classifier to quantify the racial distribution of AI-generated images across neutral prompts, 32 professions, and 8 behavioral/social attributes. The paper also measures 'racial homogenization' by calculating the average cosine similarity of face embeddings within each racial group, and uses preregistered human survey experiments to measure how exposure to these images impacts human racial biases.

Using a custom face classifier to evaluate the gender distribution of AI-generated faces across neutral prompts, 32 professions, and 8 behavioral/social attributes to detect occupational and trait-based stereotypes. The study also employs human survey experiments to assess changes in participants' gender biases after exposure to inclusive versus non-inclusive AI-generated images.
